name: oh-no-harness
description: Lightweight Markdown-first coding workflow harness with interview, ralplan, ralph, autopilot, TDD, debugging, verification, and cleanup skills.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight clarify, plan, execute, debug, and verify workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: oh-no harness provides Markdown-first workflow skills and role prompts without a default runtime daemon or hidden state. Codex registers the canonical workflow skills through native skill loading; when plugin hooks are enabled, SessionStart stays compact and a narrow Ralph prompt hook injects the Codex-specific subagent adapter.
defaultPrompt: Create a plan and execute it with verification.
